data_source_warning: All crowd data here is GAMEPLAY-LEVEL ESTIMATE. No official queue data is published. Hofbräuhaus has no reservation system for the main Schwemme floor (communal tables) — seats are first-come-first-served. Upper-floor Festsaal accepts reservations.

oktoberfest_sept_early_oct.notes: WirtshausWiesn and global Oktoberfest attention spike traffic.

floor_specific_notes.schwemme_ground_floor: Most crowded. Communal tables, live band. No reservation.
floor_specific_notes.beer_garden_courtyard: Calmer when weather permits. Closed in winter.

game_use.recommended_player_arrival_strategy: For a calm cultural visit, go 11:00 opening on a weekday. Avoid Sat 18-22 and during Oktoberfest.
game_use.language_task_aligns_with_crowd: Practicing 'Tisch reservieren' (phone reservation) works against the no-reservation policy on Schwemme — better teach 'finding a shared table' as the cultural norm.
game_use.queue_patience_lesson: Evening rush: expect 10-20 min wait + then sharing a 10-seat table with strangers. This IS the Bavarian experience.

source.label: Gameplay estimate pending review
source.basis: Inferred from: (1) Hofbräuhaus's 1000-seat Schwemme + global tourism, (2) review snippets mentioning 'loud', 'packed', 'no seats after 19:00', (3) Beer hall convention. Not based on Google Popular Times or official queue data.
